public_source_audit.source: Godin & Thivierge, PLOS Computational Biology 2026, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719, published 2026-08-25
observations: The live PLOS article still exposes S1 Code as DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002, but the available web/public transport did not yield file-level source during this invocation.

The paper explicitly states that FORCE/RLS in full neural space becomes ill-conditioned under low-rank activity, while also acknowledging that pseudoinverse formulations or rewriting learning in intrinsic coordinates could in principle mitigate this problem.

The paper states that the novelty of SPLiT is the biologically motivated online estimation/tracking of the evolving empirical activity subspace rather than an assertion that recursive least squares itself is intrinsically inferior.
public_source_audit.scope: Paper inspection plus bounded source-derived controls; no source-exact S1 Code execution or S8/S11/S12 reproduction.

bounded_audit.status: same-solver intrinsic-RLS versus full-RLS factorization; non-reproduction
bounded_audit.purpose: Remove the prior solver-class confound by comparing recursive least squares in tracked intrinsic coordinates against recursive least squares in the full ambient space under the same synthetic ambient-drift/noise model, then test sample-budget, nuisance-noise and state-cost dependence.

latent_and_observation_model.ambient_drift: true 80-degree rotation from an initial orthogonal 3D subspace toward an orthogonal complement; warmup 15%, drift over next 45%, then stationary
latent_and_observation_model.target: fixed normalized linear readout of latent coordinates

tracker.method: PAST-style normalized subspace update with QR every 20 steps and Procrustes alignment to prior coordinates

decoders.oracle: RLS on coordinates of the true current subspace
decoders.matched_solver_rule: where compared directly, intrinsic and full RLS use the same forgetting factor

design.evaluation: final 20% of each trajectory; paired seeds; bootstrap CIs over paired MSE differences

intrinsic_lambda_tuning.interpretation: 0.995 versus 0.997 difference was negligible, so matched lambda 0.995 is not a material handicap to intrinsic RLS.

dense_T3200_matched_lambda_24_seeds.summary: The prior N=20 high-budget reversal disappeared when solver class was matched: tracked intrinsic RLS beat full-space RLS at every N=20..50 cell, with all paired bootstrap intervals below zero.

lower_N_probe_24_seeds.summary: No crossover was found down to N=6, the minimum ambient dimension permitting two orthogonal 3D subspaces. Intrinsic-minus-full mean MSE remained negative at N=6,9,12,15,18,20, with all paired CIs below zero; N=6 mean difference -1.68e-5 (95% CI -2.16e-5 to -1.14e-5).

noise_factorization_16_seed_T3200.interpretation: With strong ridge/forgetting, low-rank structure alone did not cause a practical failure in the noiseless synthetic case. Material benefit emerged when intrinsic projection discarded ambient nuisance directions, and grew with ambient-to-intrinsic dimension ratio and lower sample budget.

formula.full_RLS: N^2 inverse-covariance entries plus N readout weights = O(N^2)
formula.intrinsic_tracking_plus_RLS: Nk tracker basis + k^2 inverse covariance + k readout = O(Nk); implementation may cache a previous Nk basis for Procrustes alignment

bounded_audit.interpretation: The previous apparent high-budget crossover was substantially a solver-class confound: when both readouts use RLS, adaptive intrinsic restriction remains better across the tested N range. The strongest transferable mechanism in this bounded model is not Oja specifically and not 'low rank always breaks RLS'; it is online subspace tracking followed by regression in a denoised, lower-dimensional coordinate system, yielding sample-efficiency and O(Nk) state cost. A strong regularized full-space RLS can solve the noiseless low-rank problem almost exactly, consistent with the paper's own acknowledgement that pseudoinverse/regularized or intrinsic-coordinate variants could mitigate FORCE conditioning issues.
limits: Synthetic linear-latent observation model; not the authors' recurrent network and not a reproduction of S8/S11/S12.
PAST-style tracker is generic and not source-exact Oja; this deliberately tests the computational principle rather than Oja specificity.
Forgetting factors are not exhaustively retuned in every new matched cell; matched settings were chosen from prior held-out tuning and a small intrinsic lambda check.
Noise is isotropic synthetic nuisance; real neural or AI representation drift can contain structured off-manifold signal.
Compute runtime was not hardware-benchmarked; state-cost claims are algorithmic order/counts only.
Do not generalize numeric reductions or crossover absence outside this bounded drift/noise model.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Under genuine ambient subspace drift with nuisance dimensions, online subspace tracking followed by same-class intrinsic RLS can reduce error versus full-space RLS, especially at larger N/k and smaller sample budgets, while using O(Nk) rather than O(N^2) persistent covariance state.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: Strong regularized full-space RLS solved the noiseless low-rank synthetic case essentially perfectly; low rank alone is therefore insufficient here to establish an intrinsic-coordinate advantage. Oja-specific superiority remains unsupported.

exact_next_action: Retry read-only S1 Code recovery.
